class.name: AcousticEvent
class.brief_description: A sound that gameplay makes, for enemies to hear through the Asosdot Acoustic Engine.
class.description: Describes a sound, such as footsteps, a door slamming or a gunshot, to hand to [method AcousticEngine.emit_sound]. Every [AcousticHearing3D] that it reaches then hears it. It is not played: play its audio with an [AudioStreamPlayer3D] as usual. [codeblock] var event = AcousticEvent.new() event.source = self event.position = global_position event.sound_type = &"footsteps" event.intensity = 0.8 AcousticEngine.emit_sound(event) [/codeblock]

members.member: How loud the sound is, which is how far it carries: [member ProjectSettings.audio/acoustics/hearing_range] times this. Footsteps might be [code]0.3[/code] and a gunshot [code]3.0[/code].
Where the sound is made, in global coordinates.

What kind of sound it is, such as [code]"footsteps"[/code]. An [AcousticHearing3D] can listen for some kinds only (see [member AcousticHearing3D.sound_types]), and a script that hears it can tell them apart.

What made the sound, if anything. Its body is not counted as being in the way of its own sound, and an [AcousticHearing3D] on it doesn't hear it unless [member AcousticHearing3D.hears_own_sounds] is on.
